verse: akule ca tato rudra kule ca tadanantaram | bhariteti bhairaveti raveti tadanantaram
hayamāṃsāni divyāni murtamānyadhamāni ca | mantramāni suraśreṣṭa lehyacoṣyāni homayet
astraṃ tu kālisaṃjñā *? kṣetrapālamataḥ param | tato divyāmadivyāṃ ca mānavīṃ gurusantatim
kodaṇḍadvayamadhyasthe bindvante ca namo'stu te | brahmadvāre sthite kāli vasturūpe namo'stu te
kathitaṃ tava deveśa pāramparyakramāgatam | śrībhairava uvāca tvatprasādena vai bhadre ṣoḍaśaca yathārthataḥ
avyakte vyaktibhāvasthe vyāptirūpe namo'stu te | śivarūpe mahāśānte śāntātīte namo'stu te
sṛṣṭisthaṃ viddhi sarvajña saptamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu | sthitisthaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ syāt sṛṣṭiṣaṣṭhena saṃyutam
nirdvayā acyutā śāntā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | pakṣadvayavinirmuktā madhyamāpādamadhyagā
ādau tāḥ pañcacakrasya pūjyā vandyāstu sarvataḥ | cakrasthā devadeveśyaḥ ṣoḍaśaiva mahārthagāḥ
bhavasarvāstha daskāsu yenedaṃ prāpsyase kramam | mudrāmaṇḍalanirmuktaṃ japahomavivarjitam
eṣā śatākṣarā vidyā sthiticakrasya pūraṇe | samayā sarvathā nātha samadurvāritā satī
mānuṣaiśca yathā tathyaṃ aśakyaṃ (?) tu kapāladhṛk ||1/ 48 ||
nirantaraṃ nirābhāsaṃ nirnimittaṃ nirargalam | nirākāśaṃ sadākāśaṃ sarvodoṣavivarjitam
bhairavasya samurcchasya uttiṣṭha vahatāṃ varaiḥ (?) ||2/1 ||
ānandañca nirānandaṃ sānanda rakṣace * * *? | dvitīyāṃ laharīṃ viddhi śāṃbhavī kālabhakṣakī
tasmiṃ pitṛvane ghore mahābhairavasaṃkule | kālpāstu pālyamānā vai te sthitāstviṣṭacetā
śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu rudra pravakṣyāmi vidyāṃ teṣāṃ yathā sthitām | siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca sthiticakrasvarūpagā
nirnāśaṃ nirvikārañca niravadyaṃ nirākulam | viśuddhaṃ nirbharaṃ nityaṃ anityaṃ sarvadaiva hi
catuḥṣaṣṭistu yoginyo mahārthapadagarvitāḥ ||1/ 68 ||
mantrabhūmiṃ prayacchanti sādhakānāṃ tu nityaśaḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pūjyā vandyāḥ stutāḥ sadā
sarvabhūtāstu sarve ca grastāstasmin  mahāhave  ||2/10 ||
tato vakṣyāmyaśeṣeṇa hṛdgataṃ kramaśāsanam | sarvamantreṣu yat sāraṃ sarvajñāneṣu cottamam
mukhapāraṃparāyātaṃ mukhapāraṃparojjhitam | mukhasāraṃ parāvasthāṃ ko naraḥ prāpyanāṣṇute
bhūyād bhāsakalāntare kakuhare koṭyakālollāsinī kālākālavaghaṭṭanodbhaṭatadiḥ koṭiprabhā ṭiṭṭi bhā varṇādhvāntanamantarāntara tayā līnā kṛṣāntekṣayā nityaṃ bhedakalātmakasya sahasācchedāyamātmākarī
yoginyo vyomagāḥ sarvāḥ dvādaśagāḥ samāsataḥ | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi aṣṭau devyo vibhāgaśaḥ
trikoṇasya sadā madhye pūjyā sṛṣṭistu sādhakaiḥ | si *? sha yathā nyāyaṃ yoginībhistathaiva ca
karṣayedavikalpena kalpamānā svakā kalā | tridhā mātṛvadā tryantā tāraṇī tatvamadhyagā
tato'aanyāni varṇāni ṣoḍaśāni trilocana | saṃhāracakre bhāvajña arāsu viniyojayet
śāstropāyena nirmuktaṃ paripāṭyā vivartitam | na kulaṃ kulabhāvasthaṃ na śāktaṃ śāmbhavaṃ na ca
kṛtvā svacakraṃ śrīcakraṃ kālaṃ nirnāśanaṃ param | ūrdhvariśmyārūḍhā kālī vidyārūpā manonmanī
sākinī hākinībhiśca pūtanābhiḥ samāvṛtam | bhairavaistu māhāghoraiḥ sevyamānaṃ samantataḥ
gandharvaiḥ kinnarairdivyaiḥ sādhyaiśca  vasubhistathā ||1/ 46 ||
mukharyā tu mahākālaṃ sarvasaṃhārakārakī | gopanīyāni nāmāni caurebhyo draviṇaṃ yathā
dvitīyavarṇarājeśaṃ viddhi sarvāvaḍāsakam | lakṣyā bījaṃ tato deva tṛtīyaṃ parikīrtitam
ūrdhvati vikalāntañca taśārmadhyasthitā sthitiḥ | abuddhā tu sadā buddhā bodhake vidhitā na * ?
bhūtādiviṣayairyuktā pūjyā bhasmavilepanī | ṛsyaṣṭakaṃ tataḥ pujyaṃ paścād vidyām prapūjayet
viddhi bhairavayā tattvena akramāṃ kramagocarām | tayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
ṣaṭbhāgena ṣaḍārāntā tātītā śiśivaṃ dhuta  (?) ||2/32 ||
ṣoḍaśāraṃ mahādika sṛṣṭirūpaṃ sutejasam | karṇikākeśarairyuktaṃ mahātīkṣṇaṃ suśobhanam
guptācāreṇa vai nityaṃ pañcadhā tu yathārthataḥ | idaṃ vai yoginīcakraṃ khecaratvapradāyakam
krameṇa sarva tu * *? sthitiḥ sā sarvatomukhī | tataḥ saṃhārakāraṇī kramavijñānabhakṣaṇī
sthiticakrasya bhāvajña dvitīyaṃsvasvarūpakam | sṛṣṭidvādaśasaṃyuktaṃ kuru vīrendranāyakam
melāpe militā sā vai utsarge paramā citiḥ | (9) upasthasya tu madhyagā retovāhe sadoditā
yena pūjitamātreṇa sthitijño bhavase haraḥ | pūjyaṃ tat sarvakālaṃ vai madyairmmāṃsairyathāvidhiḥ
yad jñātvā bodhaśālīnāṃ prabuddhānām umādha ca | ? khegatirbhavate sadyaḥ sarvabhāvakṣayaṃkarī
yoginyo yogamārgasthāḥ kāḥ pūjyāḥ satatoditāḥ | kairdravyaiḥ pūjayed devi sṛṣṭicakraṃ mahojjvalam
ānandapadamadhyasthe ābhāsānte namo'stu te | āhlādapadagarbhe tu vyāptirūpe namo'stu te
vadasva  tat samāsena yathāvidhiranukramāt ||2/16 ||
jñānopāsye mahājñāne jñeyarūpe namo'stu te | kriyārūpe mahārūpe viśvarūpe namo'stu te
namo harthāntu tasyaiva mūlaṃ (?) saṃharaṇe kṣame | namo'stu te mahāraudri saumyarūpe namo'stu te
cakrākārāḥ stutāḥ sarvā bodhapāna ratākulāḥ | tatrasthāḥ parayā bhaktyā māyāvad yāstu nityaśaḥ
sthitirūpaṃ mahāntaṃ vai ṣoḍaśāraṃ tu viśvagam | tadbāhye tu paraṃ divyaṃ nāma datvā prayatnataḥ
melāpe militā sā vai rasasya paramā citiḥ | (4) kapāṭadvayabhedena pakṣāpakṣadvayaratā
melāpe militā sā vai japyate paramā citiḥ | (6) phaṇirūpā pañcamukhā sarvagrāsaikatatparā
raśmirūpā nirācārā bhāvābhāvakṣaye ratāḥ | khaṃ prāptāḥ śaktimārgena tad vada me trilocane
mantrabhūmestu tā devi bhūmayaḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ | caturviṃśatibhedānāṃ samyag sūtraṃ prakāśayet
sarvamantreṣu tat sāraṃ sarvajñeyeṣu cottamam | sarvopamāmatikrāntaṃ vākkramātītagocaram
sṛṣṭisthaṃ pañcamaṃ yad vai saṃhārāt saptame yutam | daśamaṃ taṃ vijānīyād sarvakālakṣayaṃkaram
śūdrī vaiśyā tathā veśyā dhāvakī nartakī tathā
yena vijñānamātreṇa kramavijñānabhāvagaḥ | bhavate sādhakendro vai bodhābodhavibodhakaḥ
prāpyase paramaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvajñeyeṣu cottamam | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me parameśāni sṛṣṭicakrasya pūjanam
3/ khadaṇḍe tu adaṇḍā sā daṇḍāṇḍādaṇḍarūpiṇī | khadaṇḍādaṇḍayormadhye svaraśmigasaṃvartinī
sarvasiddhisukhāvasthaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam | sarvabhāveṣu sāmānyaṃ sarvabhāveṣu varjitam
melāpe militā sā vai manane paramā citiḥ | (11) pītā svasya samastasya ādyā yā bodhakī daśā
muṇḍāśca pūjayet śakro brahmā viṣṇuścarādayaḥ | siddhāśca yonayaścaiva * *?siṃkhyana(?) sarvadā
na lekhyāni ca bodhātmā na vadet sarvamadhyataḥ | na pāṭhaṃ teṣu nāmeṣu kartavyaṃ vācayā hara
saṃhāracakre deveśa trayodaśamamagrataḥ | uddharet tu vidhānena sṛṣṭirdaśamasaṃyutam
ādau tāvat mukhāmnāyaṃ svamukhacalanena ca | grāhyaṃ prāṇāntikaṃ tattvaṃ tataḥ pūjā *?ma*?bheta
kaḥ kramaḥ kiṃ kramasyāsya jñeyaṃ jñānaṃ tu kiṃ bhavet | ke siddhāstasya tattvasya kramavijñānabhāvagāḥ
tatra protā tu sā kalā nirācārā ninādī yā | arūpā ambarā kālī tithyante svasvabhāvataḥ
mukhād mukhagataṃ śūnyāmavyaktaṃ vyaktibhāvagam | sarvaśāstreṣu uddiṣṭaṃ anyagrantheṣu cottamam
kaivalyasaṃjña cāmnāyaṃ maraṇā sarvaduḥkhahā | evaṃ sṛṣṭikramaṃ vīra sarvabhāvasthamagrataḥ
teṣāṃ madhye mahābhīmo bhairavo vai nirāmayaḥ | suśrūṣo gaṅgado bhūtvā tasyārādhanatatparaḥ
agnibījaṃ tataḥ paścāt mahāśabdamataḥ param | eṣā pañcākṣarī vidyā siddhānāṃ tattvadarśinī
namo nitye tvanitye ca namaḥ sadā mahātmike | namaḥ kuleśi kauleśi vijñānavibhave namaḥ
saṃhārād dvitīyaṃ sṛṣṭeraṣṭamaṃ sthitisaṃyutam | etat tayodaśavarṇaṃ viddhi bhairava tattvataḥ
adhaḥ kalā matā śuddhā bhramantī sarvadehinām | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpa khamāgatā
tithibhirya sadārūḍhaṃ sapakṣāpakṣavarjitam | niḥsvabhāvanibhau paśya nirlakṣaṃ niṣprayojanam
etaccakraṃ tu cakreśaṃ sarvabhāvakṣayaṃkaram | sarvakāmaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvasānnidhyakārakam
pūjāsvabodhaviśānyā ko narastiṣṭhate bhuvi | śrībhairava uvāca śrutā me parameśānyā sṛṣṭicakrasvarūpadā
aṣṭamasyāvavasthaṃ tu sthitikāranasaṃyutam | navamena śirākrāntaṃ varṇamidaṃ dvitīyakam
pūrvādīśānakaṃ yāvad vāgbhavāntāni suvrate | karṇikāyāṃ tu vinyasya mandiraṃ bhīmavikramam
sarvabhāveṣu laṃpatyā yā vṛttiḥ sarvatomukhī | tasyā madhyasthabhāvena sasphurāstāsnathādhakā (?)
etāstu * *? tā devyaḥ sarvagrasanalampaṭāḥ | catvāra urmayo devyāḥ śāṃbhavyudadhimadhyagāḥ
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi śāmbhavaṃ * yathāvidhiḥ | mārgeṇa devadevyāstu laharyo jñeyasya * *?
surakṣitaṃ pradātavyaṃ sādhakāya mahātmanaḥ | etāsāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca guruvaktragatāni ca
jñāsyate paramārthatve sārabhūtamidaṃ jagat | ajñātvā tu deveśa śuddhakāryā bhavatyalam
īśvarakathitaṃ rudra sthiticakraṃ vidhānataḥ | sarvabhāvesu sāmānyaṃ sarvadoṣaistuvarjiam
trayodaśantu saṃhārāt sṛṣṭinavamasaṃyutam | aṣṭamena adhaḥkrāntaṃ caturdaśamasaṃyutam
yena vijñātamātreṇa bhavāmi kramabhājanaḥ | ke siddhāstasya tattvasya pāramparyavyavasthitāḥ
taṃ namaṃ satupasarvaṃ? ṭhakāraṃ vartulaṃ mahat | kathitaṃ tava deveśa bhāsākhyaṃ tat viduḥ padam
dhāmatrayasya sā kālī bhāsamānā aharniśi | aṃbhāṣā sarvato hikkā bhāṣakābhāṣakī sadā
tridhāvasthaṃ tridhāmādyaṃ tripravāsaṃ tricetanam | trimūrtiḥ tripathaṃ ramyaṃ akṣaraṃ acyutaṃ śivam
pādau jagrāha tasyā vai stutipūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ | abravīt tu samāsena bhairavo bhairavīṃ tataḥ
saṃpūrṇamuddhared rudra lakṣaṇe tu padaṃ tataḥ | bhavabandhani ca tathā rūpiṇīti padaṃ tataḥ
śikhāsaptakabāhyena jñānena samatāṃ gatā | kādyakodaṇḍamadhyasthā kālamahāsane gatā
saṃhāracakrād deveśa saptamena śiroyutam | saptamaṃ tu vijānīyādaṣṭamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
vidmaheti padaṃ paścāt kālīśabdamataḥ param | tatastu saṃhaṃrṣa vidmeṣa dhāmahomiṣakaṃ tataḥ
khakārākṣaramadhyasthā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā | eṣā vidyā mahāguhyā sthiticakrasya madhyagā
tena tena svarūpena vyomaiśyaḥ  sarvabhāvataḥ ||2/24 ||
